name: I-Pull
old_description: Search our in-stock vehicles to ensure you find the part you need.
about:
I-Pull by Intermountain Auto operates a self-service automotive salvage yard at 3015 North 15th East in Idaho Falls, Idaho. The company describes itself as southeastern Idaho's first self-service salvage yard, though a founding year is not publicly stated. Ownership structure and founder names have not been disclosed.

The yard allows customers to enter for a $2 per-person fee, bring their own hand or battery-powered tools, and remove parts directly from vehicles staged on site. Free equipment includes wheelbarrows, engine hoists, and manual tire-breakdown machines. I-Pull also purchases cars, trucks, vans, and SUVs in any condition, running or not. A daily-updated online inventory lets visitors search for specific vehicles before arriving. Pricing follows a published parts pricelist; core charges apply to certain components and can be refunded within 15 days with a receipt. General returns receive store credit within 30 days.

The business serves DIY mechanics, independent repair shops, and vehicle owners seeking affordable replacement parts. Its inventory spans all makes and models, supporting the automotive repair and auto-recycling sectors in the region.

The self-service model was introduced to give customers direct access to low-cost used parts without the markup of traditional counter sales. By eliminating labor charges for part removal, the yard positions itself as a cost-driven alternative for budget-conscious repair work.
